name: bootstrap-projects
description: Start Kotlin Toolchain apps for Android, iOS, desktop and web with portable agent workflows and reproducible stack selection.

interface.longDescription: Start Android and Kotlin Multiplatform development from a reviewed recipe. Choose Android, iOS, desktop JVM or browser Wasm; shared Compose or native SwiftUI; manual or Koin DI; navigation; Ktor networking and Settings storage. A portable Kotlin/JVM CLI validates compatibility, previews files, generates reproducible projects and runs selected build/test checks. Requires a local Java 17+ JDK. iOS builds require macOS and full Xcode. SDK/dependency downloads require network access. Existing projects are never overwritten. No MCP server or service account is required.
defaultPrompt: Start the step-by-step wizard to create a Kotlin app.
Help me choose platforms, UI and components for a new app.
